description: Updates a Stripe coupon's metadata, name, or currency options. Other coupon details (currency, duration, amount_off, percent_off) are, by design, not editable. Use when you need to modify coupon metadata, display name, or add new currency-specific discount amounts.

inputSchema.description:
Request model for updating a Stripe coupon.
Only metadata, name, and currency_options can be updated; other coupon details are immutable by design.

coupon.description: The ID of the coupon to update.
coupon.title: Coupon

amount_off.description: Amount (in the smallest currency unit) to subtract from invoices for this currency option.
amount_off.title: Amount Off

currency_options.description: Coupons defined in each available currency option (amount-based coupons only). Each key must be a three-letter ISO currency code with a nested amount_off value. Only applicable for amount-based coupons. Note: You can only add new currencies, not modify existing currency options.
currency_options.title: Currency Options

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs for storing additional information in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to metadata.
metadata.title: Metadata

name.description: Name of the coupon displayed to customers on invoices or receipts. Maximum length is 40 characters. Defaults to the coupon ID if not set.
name.title: Name

inputSchema.title: UpdateCouponRequest

name: update_coupon

CouponAppliesTo.description: Contains information about which products the coupon applies to.

products.description: A list of product IDs this coupon applies to.
products.title: Products

CouponAppliesTo.title: CouponAppliesTo

CouponCurrencyOption.description: Currency-specific coupon configuration in the response.

amount_off.description: Amount (in the smallest currency unit) to subtract from invoices for this currency option.
amount_off.title: Amount Off

CouponCurrencyOption.title: CouponCurrencyOption

UpdateCouponResponse.description: Response model containing the updated coupon object.

amount_off.description: Amount (in the currency specified) that will be taken off the subtotal of any invoices for this coupon.
amount_off.title: Amount Off

applies_to.description: Contains information about what this coupon applies to.
applies_to.title: Applies To

created.description: Time at which the object was created, measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
created.title: Created

currency.description: If amount_off has been set, the three-letter ISO code for the currency of the amount to take off.
currency.title: Currency

currency_options.description: Coupons defined in each available currency option (amount-based coupons only). Each key is a three-letter ISO currency code with nested amount_off value.
currency_options.title: Currency Options

duration.description: One of forever, once, or repeating. Describes how long a customer who applies this coupon will get the discount.
duration.title: Duration

duration_in_months.description: If duration is repeating, the number of months the coupon applies. Null if coupon duration is forever or once.
duration_in_months.title: Duration In Months

livemode.description: Has the value true if the object exists in live mode or the value false if the object exists in test mode.
livemode.title: Livemode

max_redemptions.description: Maximum number of times this coupon can be redeemed, in total, across all customers, before it is no longer valid.
max_redemptions.title: Max Redemptions

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object for storing additional information in a structured format.
metadata.title: Metadata

name.description: Name of the coupon displayed to customers on invoices or receipts.
name.title: Name

object.description: String representing the object's type. Value is 'coupon'.
object.title: Object

percent_off.description: Percent that will be taken off the subtotal of any invoices for this coupon (for the duration of the coupon).
percent_off.title: Percent Off

redeem_by.description: Date after which the coupon can no longer be redeemed.
redeem_by.title: Redeem By

times_redeemed.description: Number of times this coupon has been applied to a customer.
times_redeemed.title: Times Redeemed

valid.description: Taking account of the above properties, whether this coupon can still be applied to a customer.
valid.title: Valid

UpdateCouponResponse.title: UpdateCouponResponse
